arxiv-1707-00757.title: Checking account activity and credit default risk of enterprises: An application of statistical learning methods
arxiv-1707-00757.creator: Jinglun YAO, Maxime LEVY-CHAPIRA, Mamikon MARGARYAN
arxiv-1707-00757.description: Abstract The existence of asymmetric information has always been a major concern for financial institutions. Financial intermediaries such as commercial banks need to study the quality of potential borrowers in order to make their decision on corporate loans. Classical methods model the default probability by financial ratios using the logistic regression.

arxiv-2009-12813.title: Read-out of Quasi-periodic Systems using Qubits
arxiv-2009-12813.creator: Madhumita Saha, Bijay Kumar Agarwalla, B. Prasanna Venkatesh
arxiv-2009-12813.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Madhumita Saha, Bijay Kumar Agarwalla, B. Prasanna Venkatesh. We develop a theoretical scheme to perform a read-out of the properties of a quasi-periodic system by coupling it to one or two qubits. We show that the decoherence dynamics of a single qubit coupled via a pure dephasing type term to a 1D quasi-periodic system with a potential given by the André-Aubry-Harper (AAH) model and its generalized versions (GAAH model) is sensitive to the nature of the single particle eigenstates (SPEs).

arxiv-2107-02356.title: Nielsen-Borsuk-Ulam number for maps between tori The first author was supported by CAPES - Brazil, the second author was partially supported by FAPESP, Projeto Temático: Topologia Algébrica, Geométrica e Diferencial, 2016/24707-4
arxiv-2107-02356.creator: Givanildo Donizeti de Melo, Daniel Vendrúscolo
arxiv-2107-02356.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Givanildo Donizeti de Melo, Daniel Vendrúscolo. We compute the Nielsen-Borsuk-Ulam number for any selfmap of n − n- torus, 𝕋 n \mathbb{T}^{n} , as well as any free involution τ \tau in 𝕋 n \mathbb{T}^{n} , with n ⩽ 3 n\leqslant 3 . Finally, we conclude that the tori, 𝕋 1 \mathbb{T}^{1} , 𝕋 2 \mathbb{T}^{2} and 𝕋 3 \mathbb{T}^{3} , are Wecken spaces in Nielsen-Borsuk-Ulam theory.

arxiv-2107-08062.title: Using saturated count models for user-friendly synthesis of categorical data
arxiv-2107-08062.creator: James Jackson, Robin Mitra, Brian Francis, Iain Dove
arxiv-2107-08062.description: Abstract Over the past three decades, synthetic data methods for statistical disclosure control have continually evolved, but mainly within the domain of survey data sets. There are certain characteristics of administrative databases, such as their size, which present challenges from a synthesis perspective and require special attention.

arxiv-2210-02139.title: The scintillating tail of comet C/2020 F3 (Neowise)
arxiv-2210-02139.creator: R.A. Fallows, B. Forte, M. Mevius, M. A. Brentjens, C. G. Bassa, M. M. Bisi, A. Offringa, G. Shaifullah, C. Tiburzi, H. Vedantham, P. Zucca
arxiv-2210-02139.description: Abstract Context. The occultation of a radio source by the plasma tail of a comet can be used to probe structure and dynamics in the tail. Such occultations are rare, and the occurrence of scintillation, caused by small-scale density variations in the tail, remains somewhat controversial. Aims.

arxiv-2303-11350.title: Secure Integrated Sensing and Communication
arxiv-2303-11350.creator: Onur Günlü, Member , IEEE , Matthieu R. Bloch, Senior Member , IEEE , Rafael F. Schaefer, Senior Member , IEEE , and Aylin Yener, Fellow , IEEE
arxiv-2303-11350.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Onur Günlü, Member , IEEE , Matthieu R. Bloch, Senior Member , IEEE , Rafael F. Schaefer, Senior Member , IEEE , and Aylin Yener, Fellow , IEEE. This work considers the problem of mitigating information leakage between communication and sensing in systems jointly performing both operations.

arxiv-2310-16320.title: Enhancing Low-Precision Sampling via Stochastic Gradient Hamiltonian Monte Carlo
arxiv-2310-16320.creator: Ziyi Wang wang4538@purdue.eduDepartment of StatisticsPurdue University Yujie Chen chen1866@purdue.eduDepartment of StatisticsPurdue University, Qifan Song qfsong@purdue.eduDepartment of StatisticsPurdue University, Ruqi Zhang ruqiz@purdue.eduDepartment of Computer SciencePurdue University
arxiv-2310-16320.description: Abstract Low-precision training has emerged as a promising low-cost technique to enhance the training efficiency of deep neural networks without sacrificing much accuracy. Its Bayesian counterpart can further provide uncertainty quantification and improved generalization accuracy. This paper investigates low-precision sampling via Stochastic Gradient Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (SGHMC) with low-precision and full-precision gradient accumulators for both strongly log-concave and non-log-concave distributions.

arxiv-2404-02992.title: Searches for pair-produced multijet resonances using data scouting in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2404-02992.description: Abstract Searches for pair-produced multijet signatures using data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 128 \fbinv of proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV are presented. A data scouting technique is employed to record events with low jet scalar transverse momentum sum values.

arxiv-2411-19330.title: A direct measurement of the electron density turbulence parameter C 1 C_{1} towards the magnetar XTE J1810-197 Facilities: Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope (GMRT) dspsr
arxiv-2411-19330.creator: Visweshwar Ram Marthi, Yogesh Maan
arxiv-2411-19330.description: Abstract We report the first, direct measurement of the electron density turbulence parameter C 1 C_{1} , enabled by 550-750 MHz observations with the upgraded Giant Metrewave Radio Telescope. The parameter C 1 C_{1} depends on the power law index of the wavenumber spectrum of electron density inhomogeneities in the ionized interstellar medium.

arxiv-2507-03513.title: Magnetocalorics of singlet ground state induced moment magnets
arxiv-2507-03513.creator: Peter Thalmeier
arxiv-2507-03513.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Peter Thalmeier. In f-electron materials like Pr or U compounds with non-Kramers states of the f-shell the ground state may be a nonmagnetic singlet due to the action of the crystalline electric field. Nevertheless these compounds can order magnetically. They develop a ground state moment and long range order due to the spontaneous admixture of the excited state into the ground state caused by inter-site exchange.

arxiv-2602-12012.title: Decentralized Multi-Robot Obstacle Detection and Tracking in a Maritime Scenario
arxiv-2602-12012.creator: Muhammad Farhan Ahmed, Vincent Frémont
arxiv-2602-12012.description: Abstract Autonomous aerial–surface robot teams offer a scalable solution for maritime monitoring, but deployment remains difficult due to water-induced visual artifacts and bandwidth-limited coordination. This paper presents a decentralized multi-robot framework to detect and track floating containers using multiple UAVs cooperating with an autonomous surface vessel.

plaw-106-534-2000.creator: United States Congress
plaw-106-534-2000.description: Public Law 106-534 (2000): Protecting Seniors From Fraud Act

pmc-10788483.title: Evaluation of Venous Structures that Are Involved in Transsylvian Approach Using 3D Rotational Venography
pmc-10788483.creator: Yoshiro ITO, Hisayuki HOSOO, Masayuki SATO, Aiki MARUSHIMA, Mikito HAYAKAWA, Yuji MATSUMARU, Eiichi ISHIKAWA
pmc-10788483.description: In the transsylvian (TS) approach, as characterized by clipping surgery, the presurgical visualization of the superficial middle cerebral vein (SMCV) can help change the surgical approach to ensure safe microsurgery. Nevertheless, identifying preoperatively the venous structures that are involved in this approach is difficult.

pmc-11299199.title: Drug-induced kidney injury: challenges and opportunities
pmc-11299199.creator: Skylar Connor, Ruth A Roberts, Weida Tong
pmc-11299199.description: Drug-induced kidney injury (DIKI) is a frequently reported adverse event, associated with acute kidney injury, chronic kidney disease, and end-stage renal failure. Prospective cohort studies on acute injuries suggest a frequency of around 14%–26% in adult populations and a significant concern in pediatrics with a frequency of 16% being attributed to a drug.

pmc-11691128.title: ASSESSING FALLS RISK AND BALANCE SYSTEMS PROTOCOLS IN ADULT CANCER SURVIVORS
pmc-11691128.creator: Kenzi Marrone-Lloyd, Kelli Nielsen, Emma Christopher, Raegan Hinrichs, Caitlin O’Donnell, Laura Gilchrist
pmc-11691128.description: Adult cancer survivors have been shown to have an elevated risk of falling compared to control. These risks are hypothesized to be residual effects of chemotherapy treatment that can impact patients’ balance long-term through changes to vestibular, visual, and somatosensation systems.

pmc-12462721.title: A Pilot Study to Analyze the Relationship Between Left Ventricular Systole and Early Diastole: Clues Derived From Longitudinal Mitral Annular Motion
pmc-12462721.creator: Khalid Sawalha, Aakash Rana, Angel Lopez Candales
pmc-12462721.description: Background: Cardiac rotation of the left ventricle (LV) along its long axis, due to the twisting motion of the double-loop helix orientation, has been shown to explain LV systolic and early diastolic function. However, the assessment of this phenomenon using cardiac magnetic resonance imaging and speckle-tracking echocardiography is not always available and has some limitations.

pmc-12502742.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing defines developmental progression and reproductive transitions of Pneumocystis carinii
pmc-12502742.creator: Aaron W. Albee, Steven G. Sayson, Alan Ashbaugh, Nicholas J. Wolf, Aleksey Porollo, George Smulian, Melanie T. Cushion
pmc-12502742.description: Pneumocystis species are host-obligate fungal pathogens that cause severe pneumonia in immunocompromised individuals. Despite their clinical importance, their life cycle remains poorly understood, in part because Pneumocystis depends on the host environment for most nutrients and requires sexual reproduction for survival, which occurs exclusively in vivo.

pmc-12570404.title: Parental knowledge, attitudes, and practices toward antibiotic use for childhood Upper Respiratory Tract Infections in Khartoum, Sudan
pmc-12570404.creator: Rowa A. Yousif, Ahmed K. Ali, Egbal A. Hassan, Tibyan N. Mohammed, Mohammed Almotasim S. Aldirdiri, Elfatih M. Malik
pmc-12570404.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundUpper respiratory tract infections (URTIs) are among the most common diagnoses resulting in antibiotic prescriptions. Reducing unnecessary antibiotic use is critical to avoiding irrational use and antimicrobial resistance; one of the top 10 global public health concerns facing humanity.

pmc-12619589.title: The Intricate Web of MicroRNAs in Modulating EGFR-TKI Resistance in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-12619589.creator: Ying Xu, Jie Huang
pmc-12619589.description: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) harboring activating mutations in the Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) has been effectively treated with EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs). However, the clinical efficacy of these targeted therapies is invariably limited by the development of acquired resistance.

pmc-12936136.title: Genetic Polymorphism of MDM2 Gene Associates with Breast Cancer Incidence in the Lower Northern Thailand
pmc-12936136.creator: Metawee Srikummool, Maturos Nakmoo, Surasak Ditha
pmc-12936136.description: Objective: Breast cancer remains the most prevalence among women worldwide, including those in lower northern Thailand. This study aimed to investigate the association between selected genetic polymorphisms and breast cancer incidence in this regional population. Methods: DNA samples were obtained from 184 breast cancer patients and 176 healthy controls.

pmc-12999236.title: Traumatic Loss After the Sewol Ferry Disaster: Latent Profiles of Grief and Posttraumatic Stress Disorder and Their Links to Social Stress, Growth, and Quality of Life
pmc-12999236.creator: Jong-Sun Lee, Yu-Ri Lee, Jinhee Hyun, Sunju Sohn, Kyonghwa Kang, Hyu Jung Huh
pmc-12999236.description: Objective This study aimed to identify different symptom profiles of complicated grief/bereavement-related posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and examine the associations with social life factors, posttraumatic growth, and quality of life in a sample of parents whose children died in Sewol ferry accident.

pmc-13062359.title: Rare Presentation of Thoracic Outlet Syndrome with First Rib Fracture – Case Report
pmc-13062359.creator: K Rohith, Arjun Ganesh, Srinivasan Rajappa
pmc-13062359.description: Introduction:Thoracic outlet syndrome (TOS) results from compression of the neurovascular structures within the thoracic outlet. Neurogenic TOS (NTOS) is the most common subtype and often presents with non-specific upper-limb neurological symptoms, making diagnosis challenging. First rib pathology as a cause of NTOS is rare and may delay recognition and treatment.

pmc-13234624.title: A mobile intervention to reduce pain and improve health-III: protocol for a remotely delivered randomized controlled trial of physical activity for pain management in older adults with obesity and knee or hip osteoarthritis
pmc-13234624.creator: Jason Fanning, Deja O. Dobson, Sherri A. Ford, Megan Bennett, Iris Leng, Anna C. Martin, James Merritt, Fancis J. Keefe, W. Jack Rejeski, Amber K. Brooks
pmc-13234624.description: As many as three in four older adults live with chronic pain, and osteoarthritis is a leading cause of chronic pain in older adults. Knee and hip osteoarthritis being the most common forms of the condition. Osteoarthritis symptoms are worsened by low levels of physical activity, excess sustained sedentary time, weight gain, and social isolation, ultimately impairing quality of life.

pmc-13337110.title: Pericentrosomal Redistribution of the Endoplasmic Reticulum Ensures Organelle Symmetric Inheritance and Mitotic Progression
pmc-13337110.creator: Xiangyu Xu, Yalin Liu, Rongyi Wang, Wenwen Xu, Hao Shi, Ning Huang, Junlin Teng, Jin Meng, Pengli Zheng, Jianguo Chen

pmc-13414813.title: Acute TRPTI™ (oleoylethanolamide) supplementation enhances incretin hormone responses: a fixed-sequence crossover study
pmc-13414813.creator: David Briskey, Janice Pellow, Pavitra Viswanath, Amanda Rao
pmc-13414813.description: BackgroundOleoylethanolamide (OEA) is an endogenous lipid mediator involved in nutrient sensing and gut-derived hormonal signalling. TRPTI™ is a bioavailable OEA formulation designed to support metabolic and appetite-related pathways. This study evaluated the acute metabolic effects of TRPTI™ in healthy adults under controlled feeding conditions.MethodsIn this fixed-sequence, single-blind, placebo-controlled, three-period crossover study, 37 adults (BMI 25–34.

pmc-13425361.title: Metadynamics Simulations Meet Ligand Design for the Reversible Inhibition of Human Peroxiredoxin 5
pmc-13425361.creator: Laura Troussicot, Florian E. C. Blanc, Yoann Pascal, Sebastien Vidal, Jean-Marc Lancelin, Florence Guillière
pmc-13425361.description: Using insights from funnel metadynamics, a molecular dynamics protocol that provides a detailed representation of protein–ligand interactions, we investigated how a single heavy-atom modification can enhance the activity of an initial hit against human peroxiredoxin 5. This improvement was validated by NMR experiments and enzyme-inhibition assays.

pmc-13478626.title: DHX33 inhibitors induced transcriptional changes for a subset of genes in cancer cells
pmc-13478626.creator: Xingshun Wang, Yichu Fu, Xiyu Tang, Yandong Zhang
pmc-13478626.description: RNA helicase DHX33 has been shown to regulate many genes involved in cancer development. Whether or not this depends on its helicase activity remains a question. Two previously developed small molecules, BCD38 and KY386, have been shown to inhibit DHX33 helicase activity in vitro. Of them, KY386 is more potent to inhibit cancer development in vitro and in vivo.

pmc-13634123.title: A label-free supramolecular nanoassembly triggers multi-organelle crosstalk-dependent metastasis inhibition via nuclear ROS-HDAC2 axis
pmc-13634123.creator: Rujing Wang, Lan Zou, Dandan Mi, Chuan Wang, Zijian Song, Tiantian Liu, Mengnan Zhao, Dong Wang, Sanjun Shi
pmc-13634123.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Tumor metastasis, a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, presents a significant challenge due to its complex, multi-step nature and tumor cells’ adaptability. Current targeted therapies often face limitations as tumor cells activate compensatory signaling pathways, leading to drug resistance. Here, we introduce a novel molecular drug pair of sorafenib (Sora) and curcumin (Cur) self-assembled into Sora-Cur@diploid nanoparticles (diNPs), which were transformed into label-free diNP@pharmaceutical dots (diNP@PDs) with enhanced fluorescence through a specialized formulation process, eliminating the need for chemical modification.
